rows: One target contract, function policy, argument conditions and signer threshold, with optional expiry, cap and generation.
The contract whose function a rule lets be called. No rule authorizes a contract creation; the account refuses any batch that contains one.
Which listed signers must approve, as a threshold over distinct identities.
An identity whose evidence is authenticated: an *external* signer pairs a verifier contract with key material; a *delegated* signer is another Soroban address approving through the host (CAP-0071).
A generation-stamped set of rules stored under a grant ID, with its document hash and reconstruction metadata.
A rule set derived from a grant by the steps of Table 2; modeled and proven in rule-core, with no account entry point.
A capped rule's charged amounts and their ledgers, used to check a moving window.
A counter on the account, 0 at creation, advanced only by each completed recovery.
title: Terms.
caption: In the artifacts, *scope* has two meanings: a rule's target in document JSON, and an installed grant in the contract. This paper uses neither.
